title: digest answer
description: The memory tool digest's answer (SB-P5-13, migration 054; upstream's digest): the newest digest of one project or one topic tag that the caller reads, in the scope named or in any scope it reads, served as get serves a memory (source always system: the engine's label on a digest), or null when there is none; sources counts the memories it was drawn from (its drawn_from links). Only a live digest is read: in the catalog, not in the trash, not marked wrong, its window open, and not held for review (a key that selected a held one would tell what it holds). It never writes a digest, and reading it writes nothing (D-034). Listed and answered only with memory.tools on (contracts/README.md 2.1). The JSON in its text content, and on success the same as its structured content; a refusal is isError true with the refusal body.

edited.description: Only when someone changed its words or tags since it was written (SB-P5-04, migration 063: a person's or a client's edit marks it theirs, as upstream's user-edited tag does), so it is no longer the engine's line and the client's paragraph alone; an untouched digest answers without it.
